scope: unchanged migration.spec.ts assertions through actual Rust schema-10 conversion and basis/reason/copy helpers; original JS Prompts composition/history and model controls are consumers, not native Prompt/Runtime/source coverage

declarations.title: refuses a database older than schema 10 and asks for a new state directory
writes a schema 10 database in its current shape once, so nothing reads an older shape
keeps each message as a receipt of what became of it, with why one was dropped by the code the panel words it by
changes nothing when one step fails: the database stays at schema 10 as it was
reads every basis an earlier gate recorded in the current shape
writes a prompt version saved before the team sections in them, keeping its skills and auto-merge threshold, and marks it
writes saved team sections and skills under current names: earlier project names, the tools that became reads and the routing tools
writes the removed auto-merge threshold and member identities into the prompts as one new version, unless an earlier version did
reads a current prompt version that does not read as the one before it, keeping what it said
opens a database the last schema 10 build left, adds what this version keeps alongside, and migrates it
writes the Sources' records in their current shape once, so no Source converts an earlier one when it reads it
keeps each fact of a ticket once: its end, its latest report, and no worker Session it can derive
reads the reasons earlier versions stored in words as codes, and keeps any other words as written
dates each Thread from its Triggers, and keeps every Trigger's time in the one form stored times take
names the ticket it stopped at when a ticket does not read, and leaves the database at schema 10 as it was
makes the newest saved revision the current settings when it holds them, and moves a lagging pointer to it
reads the reasons a Trigger's filter and an Assignment's end stored in words as codes, and keeps an end's reason once
marks a ticket's Channel to a direct Feishu chat as direct, and links a Thread in the Lark brand when Lark links are stored
delivers the candidate of an Eval in progress at the upgrade again, so its deadline starts and it can expire
